board.title: Agent Board
board.subtitle: Private tasks. Local versions. Publishing is a separate review.
board.empty: No tasks yet. Start a task with the built-in agent.
board.unavailable: Connect the task engine to show private sessions.
board.stale: Evidence is out of date. Review the current result.
board.exportHint: Selected results only. Prompts, transcripts, tool logs, paths and credentials are excluded. Saving does not publish or attach this file.
board.reviewHint: Review applies to the exact result shown. Changed content clears this review.
board.error.stale: The task changed. Open a fresh review.
board.error.guard: Save unsaved buffers and finish pending AI reviews first.
board.error.action: The action failed. Nothing was confirmed.
board.error.export: A safe export could not be prepared.
board.unsupported: External producers are not supported in this version.
board.reviewNoWrite: This records a review of the task result. It does not write into the open project.
board.hunks.working: Agent is still working. Review opens when complete.
board.hunks.large: Too large to review hunk by hunk. It cannot be applied.
